verdict.rationale: Lium's docs refer to 'default templates' for pods, which suggests it ships its own pre-built pod templates, but nothing shows what they contain or that they cover the named ML stacks. The Jupyter toggle is a related but separate feature and gets no credit. missing for 10: documented template catalog, PyTorch/CUDA/vLLM/ComfyUI templates specifically, how to select a template at launch via CLI/API/UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch

citations.quote: pod volumes encrypted at rest by default on the default templates
